players.product: substrate / package maker buying Hanmi PCB saw-vision (MSVP) equipment

quarterly_data.signal: At KPCA show 2026 (09-09 to 09-11-2026, Songdo) LG Innotek showed an FC-BGA for AI accelerators for the first time - a large-area substrate more than 100mm per side for GPUs and NPUs, requiring higher circuit density and large-area design - and the company targets mass production of high-value FC-BGA for AI training and inference, including AI accelerators, in 2027. It also exhibited an 85mm x 85mm large-area FC-BGA and an ultra-large-area FC-BGA sample about 40% larger, plus chip-embedding technology (chips placed inside the substrate to shorten the chip-to-substrate connection and cut power loss).
quarterly_data.figure: AI-accelerator FC-BGA over 100mm per side; mass production target 2027; 85mm x 85mm and ~40% larger samples shown

quarterly_data.signal: LG Innotek is accelerating glass-core substrate development (the core layer replaced with glass to minimise warpage and circuit distortion), presented as a next-generation packaging solution optimised for FC-BGA, with a target of glass substrate mass production in 2028.

Package Solution targets: the division's H1 2026 operating margin rose from 6.5% to 10.6% (revenue +18%, operating profit +94% year on year), and LG Innotek aims to grow the Package Solution business, its future core growth axis, to about KRW 1 trillion of operating profit by 2031. The release also says FC-CSP substrate demand has diversified to high-performance memory such as GDDR as inference AI spreads, and describes its RF-SiP substrate as global No. 1 (company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: Package Solution operating profit target KRW 1 trillion by 2031; H1 2026 OP margin 10.6% (from 6.5%)
